image_description: A high-angle shot of a public toilet with a black seat. The rim of the toilet bowl is covered in layers of white toilet paper, likely used as a makeshift sanitary barrier. Additional loose sheets and crumpled balls of toilet paper are scattered on the tiled floor around the base of the toilet. A chrome flush pipe extends from the top of the cistern.
